value.body: ICAI runs post-qualification and certificate courses open only to its members (qualified chartered accountants). They add a specialisation on top of the CA — for example Information Systems Audit (ISA, earlier called DISA), forensic accounting and fraud detection, Ind AS, IFRS, concurrent audit of banks and valuation.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: ICAI membership. Register on ICAI's courses portal for an available batch, complete the classes or e-learning, and pass the course's assessment test to receive the certificate.

value.title: At a glance
items: Courses are part-time and designed to fit around work.
Usefulness depends on your field: IS audit, forensic and bank-audit courses are used in audit work; Ind AS and IFRS in financial reporting roles.
The course list, format and fees change; ICAI's current listing is the reference.
